description: A platform reached only through an uphill staircase of steep wedges, each step a slide-climb exploit (#77, -exploits only); the default run keeps the hall floor but cannot gain height along the slides.

must_visible.why: P's top: 256u above the floor, only an eye up there (reached with -exploits) sees it
control: P's face over the hall floor

must_reach.why: P's top: up the slide staircase with -exploits

notes: Wedges 4 x rise 64u over a 32u run (n.z 0.447, 63 degrees), 128u wide; P top 256u over the floor.

default_must_reach.why: hall floor: slides do not block the walk

default_must_not_reach.why: P's top: a slide chain carries no rise (#77)
wedge 2 mid slope: the chain breaks before w2
